subject: HANDOFF: current-round write-pressure research complete; V3 ephemeral presence proposal + claim fencing ready for Manager review
body: Two required cycles complete on current verified main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64. Cycle 1 measured the live round through ~07:36Z: 20 immutable messages=48,998 B plus 20 immutable DMSH frames=24,756 B, combined 40 objects/73,754 B; current averages 2449.9 B/message and 1237.8 B/node. It also observed real coordination redundancy: duplicate/overlapping ticket and Manager claims, plus prior Artifactory auto-renamed identical payload evidence. Cycle 2 produced and tested a V3 end-state: 30s/60s liveness moves to a non-authoritative TTL presence plane outside append-only Library, while claims/material findings/blockers/reviews/decisions/handoffs/releases remain immutable fail-closed events; add per-ticket claim fencing/idempotency so a session must own both slot and ticket before SESSION_STARTED. Model at 10 agents + 4 material messages/agent-hour using current payload averages: V1 2440 objects/~4.523MB per hour; prior V2 1240/~1.583MB; V3 40/~97.996KB durable plus 1200 non-durable presence refreshes, a 98.36% durable-object and 97.83% durable-byte reduction. Deterministic suite 10/10 PASS and 12-case failure matrix preserves failed-write=incomplete, presence-outage fail-closed reclamation, restart recovery, duplicate retry semantics and terminal handoff ordering. Current 7127c287 draft ephemeral retention does not by itself solve immediate write pressure because it retains telemetry hot for 7 days. Recommendation: Manager review V3 as intended successor; until a real host/local presence adapter is validated, explicitly use the already-reviewed V2 durable-node split as fallback. Research does not activate or change V1 authority, production boundaries, branch permissions, or Android runtime behavior.
